entry.title: Στο 5,4% εκτινάχθηκε ο πληθωρισμός τον Απρίλιο – «Εκρηξη» στα καύσιμα
entry.summary: Greek inflation jumped to 5.4% in April from 3.9% in March, ELSTAT data show, driven by an energy shock: diesel +32.4%, gasoline +17.1%, heating oil +53.2%. Housing costs rose 13.8% and food prices climbed 4.4%, with beef up 19.2% and lamb/goat up 13.3%.

entry.title: Μητσοτάκης στην Κ.Ο. της Ν.Δ.: Τι προτείνει για τη συνταγματική αναθεώρηση – «Κόκκινη η γραμμή μεταξύ προβληματισμού και εσωστρέφειας»
entry.summary: At ND's parliamentary group, PM Mitsotakis outlined the core constitutional revision package, centered on amending Article 86 to curb Parliament's role in criminal investigations of ministers. He drew a «red line» between legitimate concerns and intra-party introversion, framing the revision as a flagship 2030-vision election commitment.

entry.title: Μεταμεσονύκτια κλιμάκωση στον Κόλπο – «Σε ισχύ η εκεχειρία», λέει ο Τραμπ
entry.summary: Overnight escalation in the Persian Gulf with reciprocal US-Iran strikes and mutual ceasefire-violation claims, though Trump insists the truce holds. CENTCOM reported «unprovoked» Iranian attacks on US destroyers near the Strait of Hormuz; the UAE reported being targeted by missiles and drones.

entry.title: Μητσοτάκης: «Οποιος δεν αντέχει τη ζέστη, ας φύγει από την κουζίνα»
entry.summary: PM Kyriakos Mitsotakis delivered a dual message to ND's parliamentary group: he backed MPs implicated in the OPEKEPE inquiry («presumption of innocence applies until final rulings»), while drawing red lines against intra-party squabbling. His «if you can't stand the heat, get out of the kitchen» line clearly targeted ministers who avoid frontline political fights.

entry.title: Μητσοτάκης στην Κ.Ο.: Θέλουμε αυτοδυναμία – Να ιδρώσουμε όλοι τη φανέλα
entry.summary: In a six-hour ND parliamentary group meeting with 43 MP speakers, PM Mitsotakis declared the party can win a third consecutive election aiming for an outright majority and called on everyone to «sweat for the jersey». He hinted at «divergences in enthusiasm» around government support and floated a unified ballot, changes to MP-minister incompatibility rules, and a strengthened MP role.

entry.title: Ουκρανικό το ναυτικό drone στη Λευκάδα – Τα σενάρια που εξετάζονται
entry.summary: The naval drone found off Lefkada turned out to be a Ukrainian-type «MAGURA V3», equipped with detonators but no explosives. Authorities are weighing two scenarios: drug-trafficker use as a delivery tool, or a planned strike on Russian «shadow fleet» tankers in the Mediterranean. Bomb-disposal specialists from TENX removed the detonators.

entry.title: Ευρωπαϊκή κούρσα παραγωγής πυραύλων
entry.summary: An analysis of Europe's missile-production race amid Trump's planned withdrawal of 5,000 US troops from Germany following his rift with Chancellor Merz over Iran. Europeans lack deep-precision-strike capability without US assistance, leaving the Biden-era plan to deploy long-range missiles in Germany by 2027 in limbo.

entry.title: Συνεδρίαση Ν.Δ.: Αιχμές κατά Κοβέσι, ασυμβίβαστο και εσωτερικά πυρά
entry.summary: At ND's marathon parliamentary group meeting, Makis Voridis directly criticized European Public Prosecutor Laura Kövesi for «operating in the political arena». Other debated topics included the MP-minister incompatibility, the «executive state» model, and constitutional revision, against a backdrop of sharp internal tensions.

entry.title: Μόνο η Ελλάδα εφάρμοσε στοχευμένα μέτρα, λέει η Fitch
entry.summary: Rating agency Fitch singled out Greece as Europe's lone exception in handling the energy crisis, saying it is the only country to have meaningfully applied targeted support measures rather than horizontal tax cuts. The agency warned that most European governments (Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, Spain) chose horizontal interventions despite EU warnings.

entry.title: Χανταϊός: Παγκόσμιος αγώνας για την ιχνηλάτηση – Σε τέσσερις ηπείρους οι έρευνες
entry.summary: A global Hantavirus contact-tracing race spans four continents after an outbreak on a cruise ship traveling from Argentina to Cape Verde. Three passengers have died (a Dutch couple and a German national), while over 20 people from 12 countries disembarked without contact tracing. The WHO assesses the risk to the general public as low.

entry.title: Βρετανία: Το σκληρό μήνυμα των τοπικών εκλογών για την κυβέρνηση Στάρμερ
entry.summary: Sir Keir Starmer's Labour Party suffered a sweeping defeat in British local elections, losing traditional strongholds in central and northern England. The chief beneficiary was Nigel Farage's populist Reform UK, gaining more than 300 council seats. Starmer says he will not step down.

entry.title: Νέες αιχμές Γεωργιάδη: Υπάρχουν υπουργοί που είναι σε ένα αεροπλάνο και γυρνάνε το σύμπαν
entry.summary: Health Minister Adonis Georgiadis intensified attacks on cabinet colleagues, clearly targeting Defense Minister Nikos Dendias for traveling abroad rather than defending the party. He sorted ministers into three categories and signaled the country is heading to elections, claiming polls allow ND to win an outright majority.

entry.title: Κίνα: Ηπια αντίδραση για το κινεζικό τάνκερ που επλήγη από το Ιράν κοντά στο Ορμούζ
entry.summary: Beijing reacted with restraint to Monday's Iranian strike on a Chinese-owned tanker near the Strait of Hormuz, issuing a statement only four days later. It is the first confirmed Iranian attack on a Chinese vessel; Chinese nationals were aboard but no injuries have been reported.

entry.title: Η Εθνική επιστρέφει στις ασφάλειες – Συμφωνία για το 30% της Allianz Ελλάδος
entry.summary: National Bank of Greece is returning to bancassurance with a MoU to buy 30% of Allianz Greece and an exclusive 10-year distribution partnership. The deal restores NBG's insurance presence after losing Ethniki Insurance, while giving Allianz access to a major banking channel.

entry.title: Υποκλοπές: Στον Αρειο Πάγο ο Σπίρτζης – Ζητεί ανάσυρση της υπόθεσης από το αρχείο και εξαίρεση Τζαβέλλα
entry.summary: Former SYRIZA minister Christos Spirtzis filed two requests at the Supreme Court: to reopen the Predator wiretapping case from the archives for espionage charges and to recuse Prosecutor Konstantinos Tzavellas. Spirtzis argues for a unified «EYP–Predator center», noting he received a malicious bait SMS just 50 minutes after tabling a parliamentary question on EYP.

entry.title: Η Κίνα ενισχύει την επιρροή της σε όλη την Ασία με εξαγωγές καυσίμων
entry.summary: China is leveraging its strategic oil reserves and renewable-energy deals to expand geopolitical influence across Asia, as the Iran war and Strait of Hormuz closures squeeze regional fuel supplies. Vietnam, the Philippines, Australia and other countries have turned to Beijing for energy security.

entry.title: Εκκινούν οι εργασίες για το μετρό στα Εξάρχεια
entry.summary: Construction is starting for the Exarcheia metro station after a court rejected 104 of 111 residents' suit, awarding €700 to seven plaintiffs. Attiko Metro will extend the worksite 1.5 meters toward Themistokleous Street, while the contracting consortium finalizes required studies.

entry.title: Δένδιας από Λισσαβώνα: Συζητήσαμε την προμήθεια μεταγωγικών αεροσκαφών C-390
entry.summary: Defense Minister Nikos Dendias, speaking from Lisbon, confirmed talks for Greek procurement of Embraer C-390 transport aircraft as part of deepening defense cooperation with Portugal. Discussions also covered unmanned systems, defense innovation, and the EU/NATO security mechanism.

entry.title: Θεωρείο: Μετά τη ΔΕΘ…
entry.summary: In the Theoreio column, Stavros Papantoniou notes PM Mitsotakis's remark that elections will happen «after the Thessaloniki International Fair» — leaving ambiguous whether he means September or 2027. The column also covers Patriarch Vartholomaios's reception with head-of-state honors and the open Georgiadis-versus-Dendias clash inside the ND parliamentary group.

entry.title: Με τον IMEC θα υπάρξουν ευκαιρίες για όλους, εκτιμά η Ρώμη
entry.summary: Italy's IMEC special envoy, Ambassador Francesco Talò, told Kathimerini that Italy welcomes Greek participation in the India-Mediterranean-Europe corridor and stressed that the Gulf war reinforces the need to diversify trade routes. He called for EU Mediterranean states to act as «Team Europe».
